newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sankorp gets unbundling deals for Malbak.
newsitem.headline: Sankorp gets unbundling deals for Malbak.

text.p: South African conglomerate Malbak Ltd said on Thursday that its major shareholder Sankorp had struck a tender offer deal on the shares to be involved in the unbundling of its listed firms.

A tender offer is now to be made by the Public Investment Commissioners (PIC) for up to 10 percent of each of Ellerines Holdings Ltd, Foodcorp, Malbak and New Clicks Holdings Ltd and up to 15 percent of SA Druggists.

The deal has been struck to give shareholders who do not want to keep the shares they receive in the unbundling the choice of selling them to the PIC instead of into the market and possibly lowering their share prices.
The purchase price PIC will pay for the shares will be market-related and announced on April 23.
"This transaction provides the PIC with a unique prospect of securing meaningful stakes in blue chip companies at market related prices," said PIC director general Badie Badenhorst.
A second deal has seen Sankorp buy the minority holdings of Rembrandt Ltd in the firms to be undbundled in return for an enhanced stake in the "new" Malbak.
The unbundled Malbak will consist of 68 percent of packaging firm Kohler and 64 percent of London-listed MY Holdings Plc .
After the deal Sankorp and Rembrandt will hold more than 35 percent in approximately equal proprtions of the new Malbak and enter into a revised voting pool agreement, the firm said.
